text: dsh-screenshot（DSH 网页客户端插件）：为 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness 提供桌面截图。它在输入框旁添加截图按钮，并调用本机截图界面完成区域捕获。主要功能包括拖动选区、画笔和形状标注、撤销标注、复制图像到剪贴板以及保存 PNG。适合需要在 DSH 会话中快速截取并分享屏幕内容的 Windows 用户。需要 Windows 环境及本机辅助程序；不需要 API Key 或外部服务。
dsh-screenshot adds desktop capture to DSH on Windows. A composer button opens a local tool to select, annotate, copy, or save a screen area as PNG. Requires Windows; no API key or external service.
想在 Windows 上从 DSH 里截取屏幕的一块区域。

怎么撤销截图上刚画的标记？

dsh-screenshot 的功能「区域截图」：从 DSH 输入框旁的按钮启动截图界面，拖动鼠标选中桌面区域并调整选区。确认后可继续复制图像或保存 PNG。
dsh-screenshot 的功能「截图标注」：选定区域后可用画笔、直线、箭头、矩形、椭圆或文字标记画面，并通过撤销操作移除最近的修改。
dsh-screenshot 的功能「复制截图」：在截图界面点复制或完成按钮，将选中的图像送入系统剪贴板，便于粘贴到其他应用。
dsh-screenshot 的功能「保存 PNG」：在截图界面选择保存操作，将所选画面输出为 PNG 文件。

dsh-screenshot README · 特性：| | |
|---|---|
| 约 0.2 秒弹出 | 常驻预热进程，不用等启动 |
| 拖动框选 | 窗口自动识别，尺寸实时显示 |
| 标注 | 画笔、直线、箭头、矩形、椭圆、文字，`Ctrl+Z` 撤销 |
| 颜色 | 三档粗细、取色板、纯色填充 |
| 放大器 | 显示指针处坐标与色值，按 `C` 复制色号 |
| 贴边吸附 | 选区、控制点、文字都夹在屏幕内 |
| 右键取消 | 不会露出桌面右键菜单 |
| 跟随界面语言 | DSH 中文 → 中文，DSH 英文 → 英文 |
| 占用低 | 空闲约 6 MB、0.5 % CPU，空闲自动退出 |

dsh-screenshot README · 快捷键：| 操作 | 效果 |
|---|---|
| 点按钮或拖动 | 开始截图 |
| 单击 | 选中指针下的窗口 |
| 拖控制点 | 调整选区（放大器保持开启） |
| `Ctrl+Z` | 撤销上一笔 |
| `C` | 复制指针处色号（`#RRGGBB`） |
| 回车 或 `✓` | 复制并退出 |
| `Esc`、右键、`✕` | 取消 |

dsh-screenshot README · 隐私与常驻进程：不联网、无遥测、不上传：图片只进剪贴板。你不点按钮它就不会截屏；空闲三分钟自动退出，
DSH 退出后随之退出。排错时设置 `DSH_SNIP_DEBUG=1` 写 `%TEMP%\dsh-text.log`，默认不写任何文件。

dsh-screenshot README · 实现：插件 host 保持一个常驻 `SnipTool.exe`，通过命名管道（`\\.\pipe\dsh-snip-show`）唤醒并等待显式
ack：进程僵死能被立刻发现。主题与界面语言随请求下发。界面全部手绘：双缓冲位图负责压暗层与
高亮选区，分层窗口负责工具栏，小窗口负责放大器。

```
bin/SnipTool.exe      预编译原生工具
src/SnipTool.cs       全部 C# 源码（单文件）
lib/index.js          插件 host：唤醒、主题、语言、路由
lib/client.js         网页按钮与菜单

| 指标 | 实测 |
|---|---|
| 预热后弹出 | 170–200 ms |
| 空闲预热后首次 | 330–390 ms |
| 冷启动 | ≈ 1.1 s |
| 空闲内存 | ≈ 6 MB |

唤醒重试四次；若无响应，host 侧守护只杀存活超过 8 秒的进程再重启。定时器与鼠标钩子回调都
检查对象是否已释放，关闭中的会话不会抛"无法访问已释放的对象"。

dsh-screenshot README · 已知限制：仅在单屏 / 150% 缩放下验证；混合 DPI 与多屏未测试；仅支持 Windows；界面语言读取 DSH profile 里的
`locale` 配置，DSH 调整该结构时需同步更新；标注只能逐笔撤销，不能单独删除。

dsh-screenshot README · Features：| | |
|---|---|
| One click, ~0.2 s to the overlay | resident warm process, no startup wait |
| Drag to select | window auto-detect, live size readout |
| Annotations | pen, line, arrow, rectangle, ellipse, text; `Ctrl+Z` undo |
| Colour | three widths, swatch palette, solid fill |
| Magnifier | coordinates and hex under the pointer, press `C` to copy the colour |
| Edge snapping | selection, handles and text stay inside the screen |
| Right click cancels | without leaking the desktop context menu |
| Follows the UI language | Chinese DSH → Chinese tool, English DSH → English tool |
| Light on the machine | ~6 MB idle, ~0.5 % CPU, exits when idle |

|---|---|
| Click the button or drag | Start a capture |

dsh-screenshot README · Privacy：No network requests, no telemetry, no uploads: the image only goes to the clipboard. The tool
never captures the screen until you ask it to, exits after three idle minutes and follows DSH
out of memory. Set `DSH_SNIP_DEBUG=1` to write `%TEMP%\dsh-text.log`; nothing is written by default.

dsh-screenshot README · Implementation：The plugin host keeps one resident `SnipTool.exe` and wakes it over a named pipe
(`\\.\pipe\dsh-snip-show`), waiting for an explicit acknowledgement so a dead process is
detected instead of silently ignored. Theme and UI language travel with each request. The
overlay is drawn by hand: a double-buffered bitmap for the dimmed desktop and bright selection,
a layered window for the toolbar, a small window for the magnifier.

dsh-screenshot README · Implementation：```
bin/SnipTool.exe      prebuilt native tool
src/SnipTool.cs       all C# source, single file
lib/index.js          plugin host: wake, theme, language, routes
lib/client.js         web button and menu

| Metric | Measured |
|---|---|
| Warm wake | 170–200 ms |
| First wake after warm-up | 330–390 ms |
| Cold start | ≈ 1.1 s |
| Idle working set | ≈ 6 MB |

dsh-screenshot README · Implementation：Waking retries four times; if the resident process never acknowledges, a host-side watchdog
kills only processes older than eight seconds and starts a fresh one. Every timer and mouse-hook
callback checks for disposal, so a closing session cannot throw "cannot access a disposed object".

dsh-screenshot README · Limitations：Verified on a single display at 150 % scaling; mixed-DPI and multi-monitor setups are untested.
Windows only. The UI language is read from the `locale` entry in the DSH profile, so a future
layout change there needs a matching update here. Annotations can only be undone one by one.

dsh-screenshot README · Development：```powershell
csc /nologo /target:winexe /optimize+ /out:bin\SnipTool.exe `

```
